summary_text: The International School Yangon serves students aged 3 to 18 with an American core curriculum, followed by the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme in Grades 11 and 12. The student community represents over 27 nationalities and the school maintains a 100 percent university acceptance rate. Online applications for the next academic year open on February 15.
